212579559_8e3ca04f.text: The BLA is a collection of smaller cortex-like nuclei and is composed ~ 75% of glutamatergic principal neurons

212579559_51e7dd2b.text: The remaining population (~ 25%) constitutes a neurochemically and electrophysiologically heterogeneous set of interneurons

212579559_d2c2762c.text: The most salient parallels between BLA and other cortical regions with respect to their interneurons exist with respect to parvalbumin (PV) and somatostatin (SOM) positive interneurons.

212579559_e47ad3e6.text: SOM+ interneurons selectively target the dendrites of BLA principal neurons

212579559_81debee5.text: SOM positive interneurons constitute the other common interneuron population and they co-express markers such as neuropeptide Y (NPY) and calbindin
